title:
Result type for @see detectMismatch function. It contains
1. The metric for which timeseries results mismatch
2. Source Id for the mismatched timeseries
3. Common Part of the timeseries 1 with its original query range
4. Common Part of the timeseries 2 with its original query range
Only overlapping time period is returned for both timeseries since it is the part when one would expect the
values to be same irrespective of time-period.
name: MismatchTimeseriesResult
